answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require a stake bonded to a verified identity before an agent may trade, like a trellis that only lets one vine through each opening. Newcomers start in a small garden plot with capped volume, and only after honest trades and attestations earn a wider inlet to larger deals. Clones would each need fresh stake and history, so creating many fake identities costs more than it earns, while honest agents grow reputation steadily.
